data.camera: medium shot, shallow depth of field
data.description: 【空崎日奈 · 晚宴钢琴前的深情独奏】格黑娜盛大晚宴的聚光灯下，日奈换上了一袭高贵优雅的深紫色露背晚礼服，银白长发挽起露出优美修长的天鹅颈。她端坐在三角钢琴前弹奏着动人的旋律，紫红色的眼眸在乐声中深情地望向台下的你——「这首曲子……是专门为你一个人弹奏的，老师。」
data.promptProse: Hina sits upright at the banquet grand piano in a deep-purple evening gown, silver hair gathered into an elegant updo above subtle jewelry. She plays a melody while looking softly toward the teacher beyond the instrument. The medium view holds the keys beneath her hands and the piano body receding behind. Warm banquet light picks out her gown folds, while the piano lamp illuminates her fingers and polished key surfaces.
data.title: 空崎日奈 · 晚宴钢琴前的深情独奏
